description: A Minecraft Cobblemon mod that adds a new battle option that sets each Pokemon's level based on their tier on Pokemon Showdown. This enables more diverse battling where everyone can use their favorites and win.

mods.name: Cobblemon Tier-Scaled Battles
mods.description: Adds a Tier-Scaled level battle option in which each pokemon's level is set based upon their Smogon Nation Dex tier. Stronger pokemon become lower level and weaker pokemon become higher level, making more pokemon competitively viable.

releases.notes:
# Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug in which Chien-Pao and other species with hyphens did not get leveled correctly

# Icon
Added an icon to the mod
